import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acc = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
base = acc[acc.dt < '2025-09-22']
anom = acc[acc.dt == '2025-09-22']
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    b = base.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()
    a = anom.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()
    d = (a - b).sort_values(ascending=False)
    tot_b, tot_a = b.sum(), a.sum()
    print(f"=== {col} (base {tot_b:.2f} -> anom {tot_a:.2f}, delta {tot_a-tot_b:.2f})")
    print(d.head(8))
    print()
# also check num_instances and price changes at most granular level
b2 = base.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(cost=('unblended_cost','sum'), ni=('num_instances','sum'), price=('price','first'))

m = a2.join(b2, how='outer', lsuffix='_a', rsuffix='_b').fillna(0)
m['dcost'] = m['cost_a'] - m['cost_b']
m['dni'] = m['ni_a'] - m['ni_b']
